description: Gargoyle male base, UOP only (AnimationFrame*.uop). Same placement, directions and projection as the human bodies; the canvas is taller because wings and flying frames reach 199 px above the ground origin. See research/uo-conventions.md.

canvas.notes: A frame's ground origin (encoded center cx, height+cy from its top-left) lands on the anchor. Measured extents over all groups: x -103..+101, y -199..+47 around the origin. Mirroring: pixel column i -> 255 - i, joint x -> 255 - x.

blender.notes: Timeline used by the existing scenes: source frame f is keyed at Blender frame 1 + 4f. Playback timing is not inferred from the animation files.
